content: Flipping your car in Grand Theft Auto 6 works a bit differently than it did in previous games. In Rockstar's bid for realism, the team made it so you can't flip your car while you're still in it. Instead, whichever character you're controlling will have to get out of the car and turn it over. Note that flipping only works on certain vehicles, though. You can flip cars, boats, even larger construction vehicles, but not planes.
